1. Applicability and acceptance

These Terms apply when you access or use the Services, create an account, purchase a product or service, download or access digital content, submit a form, participate in training, or take an examination or assessment.

By entering into an agreement with us or using the Services, you agree to these Terms. If you use the Services on behalf of a company, school, employer, or other organisation, you confirm that you are authorised to act on behalf of and bind that organisation.

Additional written agreements, proposals, order confirmations, course conditions, examination rules, or organisational agreements may also apply. If an expressly agreed written provision conflicts with these Terms, the expressly agreed written provision will take precedence for that particular service or purchase.

2. Consumers and business customers

A consumer is an individual acting for purposes outside their trade, business, craft, or profession. A business customer is a person or organisation acting in connection with professional or commercial activities.

Certain provisions of these Terms apply differently to consumers and business customers. Nothing in these Terms limits or excludes rights granted to consumers under mandatory Dutch or European consumer law.

3. Services

We provide services relating to language, communication, personal development, expatriate support, education, professional training, digital products, course materials, examinations, level tests, quizzes, and other assessments.

Some Services are free, some require payment, and some are available only to users who have received portal access directly from us or through an organisation.

The specific content, price, duration, access period, delivery method, and other important characteristics of a product or service will be stated on the relevant product page, checkout page, proposal, order confirmation, or other written agreement.

4. Accounts and portal access

You may be required to create an account or receive an invitation to access certain Services. You must provide information that is accurate, complete, and current.

Your account is personal unless an organisational agreement expressly provides otherwise. You must keep your login details confidential and must not allow another person to use your account.

You are responsible for activity performed through your account unless the activity occurred because of circumstances outside your reasonable control. You must contact us promptly if you suspect that your account or login details have been accessed or used without authorisation.

We may temporarily restrict access where reasonably necessary to investigate suspected unauthorised access, fraud, a security incident, a breach of these Terms, or conduct that may damage the Services or another user.

5. Organisational access

An organisation may purchase, arrange, or manage access for employees, contractors, students, trainees, or other authorised users. In such cases, the organisation may be the customer while the individual is an authorised user of the Services.

Organisations are responsible for ensuring that they are authorised to provide us with personal information about their users and to request access to results, progress information, or other training records.

Where disclosed before access is granted, an authorised administrator within the organisation may manage user access and view information such as participation, progress, submissions, attempts, examination status, and assessment results.

Organisational access may be limited by the number of purchased licences, the agreed access period, or other conditions stated in the relevant proposal or agreement. Licences may not be transferred or shared unless we have expressly permitted this.

6. Orders and formation of the agreement

Product descriptions, quotations, proposals, and prices are invitations to place an order unless expressly stated otherwise.

An agreement is formed when we accept your order, confirm your registration, provide an order confirmation, grant access to the purchased Service, or otherwise confirm the agreement in writing.

We may refuse or cancel an order where there is an evident pricing or product-description error, where payment cannot be completed, where the order appears fraudulent or unlawful, or where we are unable to supply the relevant Service. If payment has already been received for an order we cancel, the applicable amount will be refunded.

7. Prices, VAT, invoices, and payment

The applicable price will be displayed at checkout or stated in the relevant proposal, quotation, order confirmation, or agreement.

Prices offered to consumers include applicable VAT unless clearly stated otherwise. Prices offered exclusively to business customers may be stated excluding VAT where this is made clear.

Payments may be processed through Stripe or another payment provider. The payment provider may apply separate terms and privacy conditions to its payment-processing services.

Business customers must pay invoices within the payment period stated on the invoice or in the applicable agreement. If no payment period is stated, payment must be made within 14 days of the invoice date.

If payment is overdue, we may send reminders and suspend paid access after providing reasonable notice. Statutory collection costs and interest may be charged where permitted by applicable law. Mandatory consumer-payment protections will continue to apply.

8. Delivery and access to digital content

Digital content may be delivered through a download link, email, user account, customer portal, or another electronic method described before purchase.

Access begins at the time stated on the product page, at checkout, in the order confirmation, or in the applicable agreement. If no specific time is stated, access will normally be provided after successful payment and completion of any required registration.

Access may be permanent, limited to a stated period, linked to a course or programme, or available only while an organisational agreement remains active. The applicable access period will be stated before purchase or in the relevant agreement.

You are responsible for using a compatible device, supported browser, internet connection, email address, and software reasonably required to access the Services. Any unusual technical or compatibility requirements will be communicated before purchase.

Download links and files may be subject to reasonable security controls, download limits, or expiry periods. These restrictions will not affect mandatory statutory rights.

9. Consumer right of withdrawal

If you are a consumer who enters into a distance contract with us, you will generally have a statutory period of 14 days during which you may withdraw from the agreement without giving a reason, unless a statutory exception applies.

For service agreements, the withdrawal period generally begins on the day the agreement is concluded. For digital content that is not supplied on a physical medium, the withdrawal period generally begins on the day the agreement is concluded.

To exercise the right of withdrawal, you must inform us through an unequivocal statement before the withdrawal period expires. You may contact us at compliance@id-develops.com or use any withdrawal function made available through our website.

Where you expressly ask us to begin providing a paid service during the withdrawal period and later withdraw before the service has been fully performed, we may charge a proportionate amount for the part of the service already supplied, where permitted by law.

For digital content that is not supplied on a physical medium, the right of withdrawal may be lost after delivery begins only where all legally required conditions have been met, including that:

  • you expressly consented to delivery beginning during the withdrawal period;
  • you acknowledged that this would cause you to lose your right of withdrawal; and
  • we provided the legally required confirmation of your consent and acknowledgement.

Where these requirements have not been met, your statutory withdrawal rights remain unaffected. Nothing in this section creates an exception to the right of withdrawal where the law does not permit one.

10. Cancellations, refunds, and rescheduling

Any cancellation, refund, or rescheduling conditions specific to a course, coaching session, programme, examination, or other scheduled service will be disclosed before purchase or included in the relevant proposal or order confirmation.

Where no specific conditions have been agreed, requests to cancel or reschedule a scheduled service should be submitted as early as reasonably possible. We will consider the timing of the request, costs already incurred, work already performed, and whether the reserved time can reasonably be offered to another customer.

If we cancel a paid service and do not provide a reasonable replacement or alternative date, you will receive a refund for the part of the service that was not provided.

Refunds will normally be made using the original payment method unless another method is agreed. This section does not limit statutory withdrawal, refund, conformity, or termination rights available to consumers.

11. Digital-content conformity and statutory rights

We will supply digital content and digital services that conform to the agreement and to the information provided before purchase, subject to applicable law.

If digital content or a digital service is defective, unavailable, incomplete, or materially different from what was agreed, you should contact us and provide sufficient information for us to investigate the issue.

Consumers may be entitled to statutory remedies, including having the issue corrected, receiving replacement access, receiving a proportionate price reduction, or terminating the agreement and receiving a refund where the applicable legal conditions are met.

Nothing in these Terms excludes or restricts any statutory guarantee, conformity right, or remedy that cannot legally be excluded or restricted.

12. Examinations, assessments, and results

The Services may allow users to complete examinations, level tests, quizzes, assignments, or other assessments and to view results, feedback, or progress information.

Unless we expressly agree otherwise in writing, results are provided for learning, coaching, placement, evaluation, or internal training purposes. They do not constitute a government-recognised diploma, formal professional qualification, immigration document, employment guarantee, licence, or regulated certification.

An assessment may be subject to a time limit, deadline, maximum number of attempts, access period, identity requirement, or specific instructions. These rules will be displayed or communicated before or during the assessment.

You must complete assessments honestly and follow the applicable instructions. Unless expressly permitted, you may not:

  • allow another person to complete an assessment for you;
  • complete an assessment on behalf of another person;
  • share questions, answers, screenshots, or protected examination materials;
  • use unauthorised notes, tools, software, artificial-intelligence systems, or external assistance;
  • work with another person where individual work is required; or
  • circumvent time limits, attempt limits, access controls, or assessment-security measures.

We may investigate suspected irregularities and may withhold, review, correct, or invalidate a result where there are reasonable grounds to believe that an assessment rule was breached, a result was produced incorrectly, or a technical or administrative error occurred.

Automated or provisional results may be corrected following manual review. Where a significant technical problem outside your reasonable control prevents completion, we will assess whether a new attempt or another appropriate solution should be provided.

Subject to payment and compliance with these Terms, we grant you a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable, and revocable right to access and use the purchased or authorised content for personal learning or internal business use.

Unless expressly permitted in writing, you may not:

Reasonable personal notes and copies expressly made available for download may be retained and used for the permitted purpose, subject to any access or licence conditions disclosed before purchase.

  • produce aggregated or anonymised statistics where permitted by law.

This licence does not transfer ownership of your submissions to us. We will not publicly publish or commercially sell identifiable private submissions unless you have separately and expressly agreed to this.

15. Acceptable use

You must use the Services lawfully and reasonably. You must not:

Feedback and suggestions may be used to evaluate and improve the Services. Providing feedback does not require us to implement it or create an entitlement to payment, ownership, or recognition.

Organisations that provide us with personal data relating to their employees, students, trainees, or other users are responsible for ensuring that they have a valid legal basis and have provided any legally required information to those individuals.

Access may occasionally be interrupted by maintenance, updates, security measures, provider disruption, internet failure, circumstances beyond our reasonable control, or urgent operational requirements.

Where reasonably possible, we will explain the reason and provide an opportunity to correct the breach before permanent termination. Termination does not affect rights or obligations that arose before termination. Provisions relating to intellectual property, confidentiality, outstanding payments, liability, disputes, and other matters that by their nature should continue will survive termination.
